FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Coulee Creek Pipe Line Co.
REPORTED BY
Control-room operator
RECEIVED VIA
Text messages
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
hey, just got word from the field near Taylor, BC. we had a release of lube oil on the 14th at
23:30. still trying to get all the details. from what i know, it was approx. 1.6 m³. it all stayed
inside the station fence. not sure what caused it, was doing some maintenance and there was a
lot of lightning in the area. will send more info as i get it.
- J. Smith, CRO
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
